description: Defines an immutable data model class TransactionModel representing a financial transaction with properties like id, accountId, categoryId, date, amount, and description. Includes methods for copying with modifications and getters to determine if the transaction is an expense or income.

classes.name: TransactionModel
classes.description: An immutable class representing a transaction record, with properties for id, accountId, categoryId, date, amount, and description. Provides utility methods for copying and property analysis.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the TransactionModel with optional modifications to its properties.

methods.name: isExpense
methods.description: A getter that returns true if the transaction amount is less than zero, indicating an expense.

methods.name: isIncome
methods.description: A getter that returns true if the transaction amount is greater than zero, indicating income.
